title: Outcomes Comparison of Robotic, Retropubic, and Perineal Prostatectomy
brief_summary: Compare peri-operative and postoperative outcomes of the three different surgical approaches to prostatectomy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age
* Radical Prostatectomy at William Beaumont Hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* Dementia
study_population: Patients undergoing prostatectomy at William Beaumont-Royal Oak.
